capabilities.footprint_note: No public venue exposes footprint aggregation. Rule 6/7 condition (b) of the ATAS engine CANNOT be evaluated here. This is a hard limitation, not a config gap.
capabilities.per_bar_cvd_note: Only Binance publishes taker-buy volume in its klines. OKX candles have 9 fields and no taker volume; Kraken OHLC is total-volume only. The other three derive flow from per-trade taker side, normalized to a fixed time window.

normalization.why: Venue spreads are NOT uniform, so a fixed threshold on raw basis dispersion fires on venue microstructure rather than on signal. Measured 2026-10-08:

basis_zscore.why: Expressing the basis in units of the venue's OWN spread makes a thin book unable to manufacture a signal out of its own tick size. A 23bps XAU basis is ~1000x Kraken's spread and ~1x nothing else; normalized, Kraken cannot dominate the ranking by having a wider book.

dispersion.method: spread-normalized max-min across live venues, in units of the median venue spread
dispersion.why: A single venue has no dispersion. Two venues give a basis but no consensus.

1.name: Cross-venue basis dislocation

conditions.a: basis_zscore of at least one venue vs cross-venue vwap exceeds z_threshold
conditions.b: dislocation persists for at least persist_cycles consecutive cycles

1.history_note: Condition (b) needs cross-cycle memory. `scanner.Scanner` now owns a `RuleHistory` and passes `history=` into `evaluate()`; before that it passed nothing, so this rule could never reach MET no matter what the data said.
1.rationale: The signal ATAS structurally cannot produce: it sees one venue. A venue trading materially away from the others while its own book is not simply wider is a real dislocation or a stale quote, and persistence separates the two.
1.audit_status: DROP refuted n=314 n_eff=192.4 t=-11.45 mean=-0.001173

direction_hint.claim: NONE. A venue trading away from the others identifies a venue, not a direction. This rule stays observation-only until a directional claim can be justified; the auditor reporting 'no directional edge' is a legitimate result.

2.name: Single-venue flow dominance

conditions.a: one venue's aggressor delta ratio deviates from the cross-venue median by more than flow_gap
conditions.b: the deviating venue's own price has NOT moved proportionally (absorption)

2.rationale: A venue showing large buying that the others do not, with price failing to respond, is absorption. Volume without price movement is the observable form.
2.absorption_note: max_price_response_bps is the effort-vs-result leg: the deviating venue's own price may move this much over the flow window and still count as 'did not respond'. It is read from this spec by the evaluator, not hardcoded. Condition (b) was previously a hard-coded UNEVALUABLE with the note 'price-response window not recorded yet', which made this rule structurally impossible to fire for the life of the engine.
2.audit_status: DROP refuted n=327 n_eff=282.5 t=-14.53 mean=-0.001181

direction_hint.claim: when one venue's tape diverges from the others while its price does NOT respond, the move follows the OTHER venues' direction (the absorbing venue's flow is absorbed, not acted on).

3.name: Cross-venue liquidity vacuum

conditions.a: touch imbalance beyond +/- vac_band on at least vac_venues venues simultaneously
conditions.b: total top-N depth falls below its own trailing median for the pair

3.depth_history_note: Condition (b) compares today's top-N depth against this PAIR's own trailing median, which requires at least 20 cycles of history before the dispersion is usable. Until then the condition reports UNEVALUABLE, not UNMET.
3.three_venue_note: UNEVALUABLE for SPCX/USD and NVDA/USD, which list on 3 venues. This rule MUST declare UNEVALUABLE for them rather than silently evaluating on 2 — a 2-venue reading of a 3-venue condition is a different, weaker claim.
3.rationale: Top-of-book depletion across venues at once is a liquidity event; on a single venue it is indistinguishable from that venue's own microstructure. Measured venue spreads differ by up to 100x, so condition (b) compares against the pair's own trailing depth median rather than an absolute.

direction_hint.claim: NONE yet. A cross-venue liquidity vacuum identifies a condition, not a side. No directional claim until measured.

4.name: Aggressor flow agreement

conditions.a: at least agree_venues venues share the same delta_ratio sign
conditions.b: the agreeing set's median |delta_ratio| exceeds flow_strength

4.tape_quality_note: min_coverage_s was 30.0. It was never enforced by any code path, so nobody noticed it was unachievable: measured 2026-10-11, OKX's trades endpoint caps at 500 trades (~5.8s of a 60s window) and Bybit reaches ~27s even at 1000 trades. Enforcing the declared value at 30s made rule 4 permanently UNEVALUABLE. It is now 5.0s, which every venue meets, and min_trades=50 carries the real precision guarantee: a delta_ratio from fewer trades than that can only take the values 0, 1/n, 2/n... and is not a measurement. Kraken returns as few as 4 trades over 25s on thin pairs, which a span-only gate would have happily accepted.
4.rationale: Aggressor flow agreeing across independent venues is the one cross-venue reading that cannot be faked by a single venue's stale quote or washed book. Requires 3 venues so a 2-venue agreement (which two correlated books can fake) is not enough.

direction_hint.claim: when >=3 venues agree on taker direction with strength, the move follows the agreed flow.

gates.min_venues_note: SPCX/USD and NVDA/USD list on 3 venues and their floor is 3, so they satisfy every rule's venue requirement. A pair whose live count falls below its floor makes all rules UNEVALUABLE and the verdict is reduced-evidence, not directional.
gates.gate_note: No rule may suppress a signal until the Phase 4 auditor has measured it with a direction-adjusted t-statistic and t < -1.65. Four rules that have never been audited must not be allowed to gate anything.

carried_overs.why: Rules 6 and 7 are order-flow rules whose condition (b) needs footprint aggregation. Shipping them here would mean shipping conditions that can never evaluate, which is the UNEVALUABLE-condition failure already documented in this repo's STATUS.md.

promotion.requires: auditor reports bucket=keep with n >= min_n and t >= -min_t on the CANDIDATE ledger for that rule
promotion.on_promotion: set audit_status to 'AUDITED keep <n> <t> <mean>' and the rule may then contribute a side to the verdict ledger
promotion.candidate_ledger: rows where candidate=1 -- carries a provisional side from direction_hint, enters expectancy math, CANNOT suppress, alert, or gate
promotion.verdict_ledger: rows where candidate=0 -- direction stays 0 until the firing rule is AUDITED; downstream reads only this
promotion.never: do not promote on the first favourable read; do not lower min_n or min_t to force a conclusion; do not infer a side from a rule's name

namespace_note: Namespace de reglas. EXISTEN DOS rules.json EN ESTE REPO con IDs numericos que se solapan (atas-bridge: reglas 1-8 de CVD/footprint/DOM; scanner-engine: reglas 1-4 de flujo cross-venue). Citar una regla sin su namespace es citar el numero equivocado. Ver docs/FIXES-gate-DOM.md Fix 4.
